segments.text: Engines wake beneath the violet sun
Black glass trembling, countdown begun
I leave my name where the radio glows
Then follow the signal nobody knows
Past the dead satellites and their blinking scars
I steer by static and unfinished stars
Earth folds down to a pale blue coin
while the hall keeps time with the asteroid noise.
There is something breathing beyond the charts,
sending little cold knocks through the ship's steel heart.
I turn every dial till the red lights sting.
I bring my mic up to Uranus and I sting.
I'll be solo, Eubilea, cause the player got a swing.
No map in my pocket, no moon in the glass.
Just a voice from the fort saying, come on past.
If the night wants a name, I will give it mine.
Then I'll brunt my shadow at the edge of time.
Ride that midnight career where the lost worlds shine.
Bass pulse under me, danger close behind.
I came for the distance, I stayed for the sound.
Where the stars fall silent and the dark comes around.
That sent my song through the cold unknown
Four small words on the carrier's own
Keep that blue world turning till I get back home
Had a room and a couloir in my big Chevy
Now my bed is a harness and the air feels heavy
There are storms on Saturn like a crown of knives
And a red dust moon where nothing survives
I find an old beacon with a fractured face
Still whispering cornets into empty space
Or maybe even to a writer's face
Buy some Mars and Jupiter's tickets from my guitar case
But the farther I travel, the clearer it gets
Every bright new frontier leaves a trail of deaths
Ride that midnight, hurry where the lost worlds shine
Baseball's under me, danger, close behind
i came for the distance i stayed for the sound where the scars fall silent and the dark comes
around and send my song through the cold unknown four small words of the carrier zone and keep that
blue world turning till i get back home then the signal opens like an eye in the deep
Shows me every promise that the darkness keeps
Cities made of crystal oceans without shores
Every missing traveler standing at their doors
I cut the main receiver, let temptation fade
Turn the ship toward morning through the mess I made
The unknown keeps calling
But I know it's cost
You can chase every wonder and become what it lost
Ride that midnight current, let the engines climb
Earth is still a heartbeat on the edge of time
I carried back the silence and the things I found
A scar across the star map and a low machine sound
Send my song through the cold unknown
Tell them I was frightened, tell them I flew on
When the blue world rises in the forward glass
I will spend one quiet breath on all that past
No fruit in the heavens, no world I can own
I charted the dark and the dark sang me home
